baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic documentary photograph of one original fictional adult woman firefighter during a chemical-plant emergency-standby inspection in freezing rain. She is shown nearly full length beside exposed pipes and a foam-monitor station, visibly checking the pressure gauge and coupling on a staged hose line with both gloved hands. She wears a complete operational protective system: a hard firefighting helmet with lowered clear eye shield, a high-collared flame-resistant turnout coat and matching trousers with broad reflective bands, an air cylinder and harness secured on her back, heavy protective gloves, and sturdy black firefighting boots. Ice beads on the gear and rain streaks across the metalwork; cold vapor hangs around the valves. Keep her face visible beneath the helmet and use the supplied image only as guidance for a calm front-facing facial appearance, long dark softly waved hair tucked securely into the collar, and restrained natural makeup. Frame from helmet to boots at eye level so the equipment, hand-to-gauge action, wet protective layers, and hazardous industrial context all read immediately. Use cool storm daylight, red emergency spill light, realistic fabric wear, wet reflections, and crisp documentary detail.
